audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read 'Yone' while content win[0..6] read 'Brand', the packet levelChart reads Brand on every row, and each phases[N].why describes Brand winning that stage.
audit.why: The side column is the outlier against the packet, the content layer and its own why sentences.
audit.corrected: Flipped all seven sides to Brand as one atomic group and rewrote every why with Yone-specific ranges and cooldowns. win[0..6] already read 'Brand', so the pairs agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d asserted a 'fifteen-second' Soul Unbound, and no spike named a real Yone cooldown.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10, Spirit Cleave a flat 14, Fate Sealed 120/100/80, Mortal Steel 4.
audit.corrected: Real numbers now in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d, the phase whys, spikes[2] and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: NINE fields told the player about Yone's 'Wind Wall'. Yone has no Wind Wall — that is Yasuo. Separately, four fields credited the stun to Conflagration (E); Brand's stun is on Sear (Q), and only against an already-ablaze target.
audit.why: Yone's W is Spirit Cleave, a cone that shields him and scales with champions hit — a shield to be baited, not a projectile block. A player following the old text would hold Sear expecting a wall and mis-order the entire combo.
audit.corrected: Replaced every Wind Wall reference with Spirit Cleave's 14s shield (this is also the missingInteractions shield-absorbs-burst entry) and restated the combo as E-ablaze then Q-stun throughout.

audit.why: Soul Unbound's 22s rank-1 cooldown is the field's whole point.
audit.corrected: Now carries E 22s/10s, W 14s, R 120s, Sear 8s.

audit.why: champ-gender.js does not list yone as female; the owner is addressed as 'you', so third person is Yone.
audit.corrected: Rewritten in he/his and grounded in his Q dash.

edits.before: W-poke his last-hits from max range — the pillar chunks early and the lane learns to flinch by level 2.
edits.after: Pillar of Flame at 900 outranges Mortal Steel's 450 — he pays health for every last-hit he walks up to take.

edits.before: E joins: the point-and-click ablaze into Q-stun threat is already a kill pattern with jungle help.
edits.after: E joins: ablaze him point-blank and Sear becomes a stun on the walk-up he cannot dash out of.

edits.before: Full kit: E-Q stun into W is half a health bar at level 3. He respects every cast from here or pays.
edits.after: At level 3 E-Q-W chunks him, and Spirit Cleave's shield on a 14s cooldown covers one cast of three.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — rotation poke on every wave contact. Blaze stacks make even chip trades unfair.
edits.after: Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 — while it is down he has no way to reach you through the pillar.

edits.before: Pyroclasm online — any clumped trade is now a detonation chain. Lane all-ins favor the arsonist.
edits.after: Fate Sealed pulls a whole line in, so hold your R for the clump he gathers rather than for him.

edits.before: Liandry's spike: the burn makes every rotation percent-health math. Force extended exchanges.
edits.after: Liandry's spike: burn ticks on past the Spirit Cleave shield he refreshes only every 14s.

edits.before: Late Brand is a teamfight detonator: spread Blaze, R the clump, and watch three health bars argue with physics.
edits.after: Late, he blinks the backline with Fate Sealed on 80s — spread Blaze with E and R the line he drags together.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. It governs your forward steps. - E-Q stun package spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound (E): 22s at rank 1, 10s maxed — spirit form is his burst window, so survive it and punish the body it snaps back to. - Spirit Cleave (W) shields him every 14s. - Fate Sealed is 120s at rank 1; your Sear is 8s, so bank it.

edits.before: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Conflagration ablazes on cast inside 625, and only then does Sear stun — never the other way round.

edits.before: E the instant ablaze, Q the stun, W the stunned body, walk — the full package chunks half a bar and the burn writes the receipt.
edits.after: Mortal Steel's third stack dashes him forward — pillar the ground between you and the delay lands exactly as he arrives.

edits.before: Yone burns Soul Unbound on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Soul Unbound spent on nothing leaves 22 seconds at rank 1 to walk him down.

edits.before: That’s Yone’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Pillar-only poke leaves Sear unbanked while his Q dash costs him nothing.

edits.before: Your stun only exists on ablaze targets — a Q thrown at a clean health bar is the most expensive miss in your kit.
edits.after: Inside 450 every second attack of his adds magic damage on top, while your Conflagration sits on a 13s cooldown.

edits.before: W-poking on cooldown with Q unbanked while his engage is loaded — Brand without the stun threat is a bonfire waiting for company.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave shields him for more the more champions it hits — burst into a fresh shield and your 13s Conflagration bought nothing.

edits.before: Track Yone’s Soul Unbound: His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Soul Unbound (E), 22s at rank 1: the spirit repeats its damage on snap-back, so survive it and punish the body.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Yone wins by stacking Mortal Steel into the dash, shielding your burst off with Spirit Cleave, and pulling you in with Fate Sealed.

edits.before: Carry through AoE math — no burst mage damages three targets like Brand; your job is the spacing that lets the bounces vote.
edits.after: Carry by spacing outside 450 — every pillar and bounce is free while Soul Unbound is the only thing that can close it.

edits.before: If Yone opens the score, reset expectations and respect Soul Unbound doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with W-E clears and stay relevant through stun-burn peel.
edits.after: If Yone opens the score his crit and attack speed arrive early — farm with W-E from 900 range, never step inside 450 with Sear unbanked, and stay useful as stun-burn peel in fights.

edits.before: Ult trade favors you: Pyroclasm chains through skirmishes better than his single-target dash, and Wind Wall can't stop stacked spells.
edits.after: Ult trade favors you: Fate Sealed drags a line into one place, which is precisely the clump your Pyroclasm bounces were built for.

edits.before: Late-game AoE burst deletes squishies before he can dash in, and one Wind Wall doesn't stop a full rotation.
edits.after: Late-game AoE burst spreads Blaze across the group faster than one Spirit Cleave shield on 14s can absorb.

edits.before: Your Pyroclasm (R) bounces off his dashes and minions in cramped mid lane skirmishes, and Conflagration's stun lets you convert a landed Q into a full combo before he can Q3 flash-cancel out.
edits.after: Pyroclasm bounces between him and the minions in a cramped mid skirmish, and because Conflagration ablazes on cast your Sear converts into a stun that locks him before the third Mortal Steel lands.

edits.before: Luden's Companion/Liandry's burst plus his Wind Wall only blocking one projectile means you can layer W into E to guarantee at least one spell connects during his all-in windup.
edits.after: Liandry's burst plus a Spirit Cleave shield that only refreshes every 14 seconds means layering W into E during his wind-up puts burn on him faster than one cleave can absorb.

edits.before: Your AoE burst deletes his whole team in one Pyroclasm bounce chain if he ever dives your backline, and Wind Wall can't block a fight that's already started with W on the ground.
edits.after: Your AoE burst punishes his whole team the moment Fate Sealed pulls them into a line, and a pillar already on the ground keeps burning while he is still mid-blink at 1000 range.

edits.before: You outrange every trade Yone can make in lane before level 6 — Pillar of Flame punishes his farming pattern and he has zero way to close the gap safely. He has to either give up CS under poke or walk into stacked Q+E damage, and Conflagration's stun means any all-in attempt gets shut down before his blade even lands twice.
edits.after: You outrange every trade Yone can make in lane before level 6 — Pillar of Flame at 900 punishes his farming pattern and Mortal Steel only reaches 450. He has to give up CS under poke or walk into stacked W+E damage, and once he is ablaze your Sear stuns him before the third Mortal Steel ever lands.

edits.before: Level 6 gives him Pyroclasm as an escape and engage tool, but your own ult bounces through the chaos of a lane skirmish and rewards you for grouping damage on top of him. Wind Wall stops a single spell, so layering W (ground zone) with E (stun) into Q still gets a spell through, and your damage output per rotation stays well ahead of his melee trade pattern this whole phase.
edits.after: Level 6 gives him Fate Sealed, which blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls everyone hit toward him, so never line up with your team. Your own ult wants exactly that clump, and Spirit Cleave only shields once every 14 seconds, so layering W into E puts burn on him faster than one cleave absorbs, and your damage per rotation stays ahead of his melee trade pattern this whole phase.

edits.before: With Luden's or Liandry's online your burst one-rotations squishies from range, which is exactly the matchup Yone struggles to flip — he has no gap-closer that beats your kite pattern in a straight fight, and his Wind Wall can only ever save him from one instance of damage while your kit is built around layering several.
edits.after: With Luden's or Liandry's online your burst one-rotations squishies from range, which is exactly the matchup Yone struggles to flip — his only ways in are Mortal Steel at 450 and Fate Sealed on 80 seconds, and Spirit Cleave shields him once every 14 while your kit layers damage over four seconds of burn.

edits.before: Hold Conflagration (E) until he commits Q3 dash so the stun lands instead of getting Wind-Walled
edits.after: Hold Conflagration (E) until he commits the Mortal Steel dash, then Sear stuns him on arrival

edits.before: Poke with Q on cooldown from max range whenever he's forced to walk up for CS
edits.after: Poke with Pillar of Flame from 900 range whenever he is forced to walk up for CS

edits.before: Bait his Wind Wall with W ground-target before flashing in your real combo
edits.after: Bait Spirit Cleave with a Pillar of Flame before you commit the real rotation

edits.before: Save Wind Wall specifically for your E stun, not your Q poke
edits.after: Save Spirit Cleave for the real rotation, not for Pillar poke

notes: This matchup was the worst-contaminated of my slice: nine separate fields described Yone using Yasuo's Wind Wall, and four attributed Brand's stun to Conflagration (E) rather than Sear (Q). The packet defect line ('never names any of Yone's abilities') understates it — the page named the wrong champion's ability instead. All nine are corrected. Note that Yone's Soul Unbound has range 25000 in the kit file, which is the spirit's leash rather than a cast range, so I did not quote it anywhere. diff/diffRating (HARD 8/10) still disagrees with a 50.7% win rate and an all-Brand level chart — see questionsForUser.
